titles.title: The Day When Parallel Lines Meet

description:
Eighteen years ago, a nightmare-like incident left deep scars on Jinhyuk and Taehyun. Even now, it is difficult for them to express their true feelings. Can the two of them ever find their way back to the same place, together?

**Original Webtoon:**
